Definition: Ananjah, the name of an Israelite and of a place in Palestine
BiblicalUsage: Ananiah = "Jehovah clouds"; n pr m; 1) ancestor of Azariah who assisted in rebuilding the city wall in the time of Nehemiah; n pr loc; 2) a city northwest of Jerusalem to which some Benjamite exiles returned
